title: When the inner thread feels used past its strength
issueStatement: You are still moving, but the soul has begun to fray. Everything sounds urgent, and even good counsel can feel like one more demand.
centralInsight: Gurbani does not answer exhaustion with intensity. It answers by cooling the body and mind, returning the heart to care, and ending the restless search for relief in the wrong places.
practicalReflection: A worn soul often mistakes motion for survival. The Guru keeps turning it toward shelter, company, and a smaller faithful return.
actionPrompt: Let one burden drop today, then keep one simple practice that gives rest instead of pressure.
